Hi Maya — looping in the listing ops details here. See attached checklist and a short mapping we use internally. Attachment stubs included below.

Summary (high-level):
- AWS Marketplace: two typical tracks — (1) AWS SaaS Contracts (transactable) and (2) Private Offers (procurement-managed). Listing requires Partner Network enrollment (if not already), an AWS Marketplace product listing, and a pricing addendum or metering integration depending on the SKU type. Time-to-list: ~4–8 weeks (depends on AWS PN enrollment + security evidence).

- Azure Marketplace: supports transactable and consultative listings. Azure requires MPN registration and a commercial marketplace agreement. Time-to-list: ~6–10 weeks (publisher onboarding + legal review).

- GCP Marketplace: more varied — some SaaS listings require a partner submission and technical integration; GCP often needs additional partner entitlements. Time-to-list: ~6–12 weeks.

Security & legal evidence we commonly submit:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12 months)
- Data Processing Addendum (standard DPA or SASB clause)
- Encryption details (TLS in transit; AES-256 at rest where applicable)
- Tenant isolation architecture note (for Dedicated/private deployments)
- Pen test summary and remediation timeline (if requested)

Billing options & commercial notes:
- Marketplace-managed billing (AWS/Azure) typically routes revenue through the cloud marketplace; payout windows vary (30–60+ days). This affects revenue recognition and sometimes requires a separate commercial addendum.
- Direct invoicing (Redwood invoices OmniRetail) is available for Dedicated/Enterprise contracts; we can offer monthly consolidated invoices.

Required items from OmniRetail to start listing:
1) Confirm target marketplaces (AWS, Azure — per your note).
2) Legal point of contact + billing entity information (W-9 / tax ID and bank wiring details).
3) SOC 2 or equivalent evidence acceptance window (we can share a redacted report).

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_marketplace_checklist.pdf (marketplace-by-marketplace step list)
- redwood_sla_pricing_addendum_template.docx (pricing & SLA addendum template we use for marketplace transactable deals)

Related drive doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-redwood-marketplace-onboarding

Next steps:
- If you confirm AWS + Azure, Karthik will start the partner enrollment/listing submission and Lauren will engage legal for addendum review.
- Please provide the procurement contact and any internal procurement forms.
